definitions.short: a vine blossom ; used also adverbially, abloom
definitions.full: H5563. semadar [ סְמָדֵר ?], also סְמָדַ֑ר סְמָדַ֔ר֖, noun masculine Song 7:13 blossom of grape (just at flowering Duval REJ xiv (1887), 227 ff. Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic סמדר , , Mandean סימאדרא Nö M. 128 ); — always absolute ׳ס , only Canticles: סְמָדַר֖ הַגְּפָנִים 2:13 the vines are (all) blossom ; סְמָדַ֑ר כְּרָמִים 2:15 (on bold predicate compare Ges § 141d ); הַסְּמָדַ֔ר מִּתַּךְִ 7:13 the blossom has opened (its buds).
